entities.summary: Bodo Hell is an Austrian writer. He studied the organ at the Mozarteum in Salzburg, and in Vienna he studied film and television, philosophy, German studies and history. He lives in Vienna and Dachstein, Styria. He has worked with, among others, Friederike Mayröcker, Ernst Jandl, Liesl Ujvary and Hil de Gard.
